name: TopPSample
reference:
import torch
import torch_npu

def run(logits, top_p, eps=1e-8):
    batch_size = logits.shape[0]
    device = logits.device
    top_k = torch.ones(batch_size, 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
    return torch_npu.npu_top_k_top_p_sample(logits, top_k, top_p, q=None, eps=eps, is_need_logits=False, top_k_guess=32)
description: Top-P (nucleus) sampling. torch_npu.npu_top_k_top_p_sample with invalid top_k to skip topK filtering. top_p can be float or [batch] tensor. Returns (sampled_indices, filtered_logits). Pure PyTorch: softmax, sort descending, cumsum, mask above top_p, sample from filtered.
